notes.what_it_is: one part's run of `spec-to-inspector inspect`: the specification's PDF parsed, the part's whole test split scored, every board judged, the reject cards and the report written
notes.no_accuracy: this record gives no accuracy figure: the final figure stands and is not re-read from a batch
notes.times: `times` is the protocol's figure 7, counted by the bench's `stage_times`
notes.inspector: `inspector` is figure 8: parse time measured in this run plus the fit time recorded when the part's model was trained on the machine; training is not repeated
notes.memory: `memory` is figure 9 by stage, from readings of both cards at the interval it gives, every reading in the file it names; `run.memory` and `judge_memory` are the same stages laid out as the bench lays them. A stage shorter than the interval may have no reading
notes.whole_seconds: `whole_seconds` is this process's own, from the first check to the record; the whole run's wall clock is the wrapper's, which starts before Python does
notes.units: *_seconds and seconds are wall-clock seconds; *_mib is MiB as the card's tool reports it; minutes are seconds / 60; *_bytes are bytes, *_disk_bytes as allocated on the disk
